messages:
Lina (CSE): Heads up — AcmeCorp renewal signing is blocked. DocuSign returns a 'vendor_code mismatch' when we try to send the envelope for the EU billing entity. Need procurement + legal eyes.

Raj (Account Manager): Ugh. Timeline? Customer expects signature by EOD tomorrow.

Lina (CSE): Root error from the provider: 
```
{
  "error": "VendorCodeMismatch",
  "details": "expected vendor_code 'ACME-EU', got 'ACME'",
  "envelope_id": "0ab123"
}
```

Noah (Ops): Quick context — this account uses customer-managed KMS mapping on Private. Our signing integration maps vendor_code from the billing_entity field. Looks like the billing entity in the renewal packet is still the parent 'ACME' not the EU subsidiary.

Sam (Billing): Confirmed — procurement uploaded the PO under the parent acct (ACME) instead of 'ACME EUROPE'. That causes the vendor_code mismatch. We can update invoice metadata but legal needs to sign off on invoice entity change for this renewal.

Marta (Legal): If the entity on the invoice doesn't match the signer entity for the contract, we need an explicit amendment or a letter of authority. That's why e-sign fails for our automated path. Two options: 1) update the renewal packet to EU entity now (procurement + billing) or 2) have customer sign under parent entity and process an internal credit/transfer after. Both require approvals.

Raj (Account Manager): I just spoke to Acme procurement — they can reissue PO if we tell them exactly what field to change.

Lina (CSE): Practical blocker: DocuSign envelope creation fails pre-sign, so we can't attach a manual signature URL. Workaround idea: generate a manual PDF, send it to customer for wet/e-sign on their side, then we ingest. But that's messy for compliance.

Eli (Platform): Short-term workaround: we can bypass vendor_code check for this single envelope and create a one-off envelope using the platform service account. Requires Ops + Legal signoff in ticket. Long-term fix: make vendor_code mapping resilient to subsidiary aliases.

Noah (Ops): If Legal approves, I can run the one-off and mark it as exceptional. I'll need written approval from Marta and a procurement confirmation that the PO will be reissued or remediated within 7 days.

Marta (Legal): I can approve conditional exception if: (a) customer signs under parent entity with a clause acknowledging entity reconciliation, and (b) procurement confirms PO update ticket is opened. I need copied email to legal-records@redwood.com.

Sam (Billing): I'll create the PO correction request template for AcmeProcurement — will paste the exact key/value they need to change (billing_entity: "ACME-EU", vendor_code: "ACME-EU").

Raj (Account Manager): I'll ask Acme to sign under parent entity as temporary and send legal confirmation. Also asking them to reissue PO today.

Lina (CSE): Action items: 
- Raj: get customer's written ack to sign under parent entity (due: today EOD)
- Sam: open PO correction template and share with Raj (due: 2 hours)
- Noah: standby to run one-off envelope if Marta gives approval (due: on approval)
- Marta: confirm conditional approval once we have PO ticket + customer email (due: today)

Eli (Platform): I'll file a ticket for the mapping resilience change (longer term) and include example logs. Ticket: PLAT-5643 (I'll update once created).

esign-bot: DocuSign API log recorded: envelope create failed 3123456798 — vendor_code mismatch.

Lina (CSE): Thanks all — I'll thread the customer email here once Raj posts. We're marking renewal at-risk until we get either reissued PO or legal exception.

Raj (Account Manager): Customer replied — they can sign under parent entity now and will reissue PO by COB. Copying their short email below: 
"We accept signing under Acme Holdings for the renewal to meet the deadline. PO reissue to Acme Europe in progress, will share the reference number when available."

Marta (Legal): Received. I approve the conditional exception. Noah, you can proceed with the one-off envelope using platform account. Please ensure legal-records@redwood.com is cc'd on the final.

Noah (Ops): Proceeding now. Will post envelope id and confirmation.

esign-bot: envelope id 0ab123 altered -> recreated as 0ab124 by Noah (Ops) at 3123456854. Status: sent.

Noah (Ops): Sent. Customer confirmed signature completed at 3123456858.

Lina (CSE): Signing complete. Raj — please confirm when the PO reissue reference comes in so billing can reconcile.

Sam (Billing): I'll reconcile once PO reference is in and close the temporary exception internal ticket.

Lina (CSE): Closing notes for audit: saved approval email from customer + Marta approval, ops one-off envelope record, and PO correction ticket link (will append). Marking thread resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
